scope: Retained persistent Vector, Map, Range and String split acceptance through Oops, including collecting callbacks and precise lifetime checks
retained_checks: 1100 Vector additions with snapshots across tail and tree growth boundaries; independent Rust sequence oracles.
Ten stable-sort keys survive collecting callbacks and are reclaimed after success; both keys preceding the third-call native failure are reclaimed.
Iteration observes callback replacement after its first call; folding retains only the final answer.
Persistent Map updates, binary String and numeric key semantics, 40 colliding keys and collecting reentrant equality.
Inclusive Range checks cover both i64 endpoints, empty and unrepresentably large ranges.
Binary-safe splitting retains empty/trailing fields and observes collecting String and Vector factory replacements.
Precise GC excludes address-shaped numeric bits, preserves private collection behavior, and retains text only while its collection holder is rooted.
Malformed Map and Vector reference slots fail through owner messages.
